verdict.rationale: Dagster's Schedules support cron expressions and common intervals (hourly/daily/weekly), Sensors enable event-driven/manual-like triggers, and manual triggers via UI/API are implied throughout the automation docs; integrations like Airbyte/Fivetran/dbt sync orchestration can be scheduled per-pipeline. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sub-hour interval configuration examples and independent hands-on confirmation of per-pipeline frequency control.
